## Abilities & Class Features

- **Wild Shape (Circle of the Moon):** Wolf form (S02). Giant spider form (S06 — twice). Spider form grants wall/ceiling climbing, web shooting.
- **Goblin Wild Shape (S11 homebrew):** Can use wild shape charge to become a goblin. Keeps own stats but gains goblin appearance and Fury of the Small. Duration: 1 hour (per DM). Empowered by Chris (fae goblin leader).
- **Tremorsense (Dwarf racial):** 60 ft for 10 minutes, bonus action. Must be on stone.
- **Stone Cunning (Dwarf racial):** Referenced S06.
- **Poison Spray:** Used S01 vs giant spider. Spider appeared immune.
- **Produce Flame:** Used S02 vs quaggoth (1 fire damage).
- **Starry Wisp:** Radiant damage, creature emits dim light 10 ft, can't benefit from invisibility. Used S06 Combat 1 (22 to hit, 3 radiant).
- **Hold Person:** Cast on Turvy during wererat fight (S04); successfully paralyzed him.
- **Moonbeam (2nd level):** Radiant damage AoE. Used S06 Combat 3 on oozes B+C. Used S08 on Black Pudding (30 total).
- **Cure Wounds:** 2nd level, 23 HP on Amanita (S03). 8 HP on Turvy (S05). 15 HP on Binks (S06). 19 HP on Kit (S08).
- **Healing Word:** Healed Aeolus in pool (S03).
- **Help Action:** Provided Help to [[Binks Stonevein]] for Resurrection scroll check (S09).
- **Herbalism Kit:** Proficient. Used S06 alongside medicine check.
- **Medicine:** 25 on Binks (S06) — diagnosed TBI, burst eardrums.
- **Arcana:** 22 on Glabbagool (S06). 25 (23 adjusted) on Feydark portal (S09).

### S25 Key Events ([[Session 25 — Nevermind. We're Going|Session 25]])

⭐ **The session's engine, and the session's best gift — in the same ten minutes.**

- **He is the reason the extraction worked.** With [[Darby Stonefeather]] failing to muscle out of the webbing and the group-pull plan dead against an average DC 25, **Blarg's nature 25** established the load-bearing fact: **the webbing burns faster than the goliath does.** Addison: *"between the two of you, just with that check alone, 25."* He then layered a **fire-resistance cantrip** on Darby anyway, after [[Amanita de'Champignon]]'s Absorb Elements ritual came up short.
- **The wine.** Nature **18** toward growing the magma grape, plus **Guidance** cast on [[Aeolus]] that gave him the advantage he explicitly said he needed — *"I can say that the advantage was really needed for the nature."* His own contribution to the plan was cheerfully unqualified: *"I don't know a lot about growing plants myself, so I don't know what I will tell them. Maybe fertilize the soil or something."*
- 🏆 **HE HEARS [[Selûne]] FOR THE FIRST TIME IN HIS LIFE — *"despite the nat one."*** He had just rolled a **natural 1 on religion** in the same breath. Addison gave it to him anyway: ***"You hear. You literally hear for the first time in your life, Blarg, despite the nat one. You hear your goddess. You hear Selûne."*** He sees her **in the magma** — moonlight *"piercing pale"* against the orange — and ***"No one else sees it, Blarg. But you see the moon."*** This is the direct answer to his S08 complaint about shouting into a pillow, and it lands on a failed roll and costs him nothing. Addison then made him roll a **madness save at disadvantage** and he cleared it at **17** on a **+8 Wisdom**, keeping the 9 — Florian, apologetic: *"I'm sorry. It's just too high."* Addison, defeated: *"Damn it. One of these days, man."*
- 🛑 **But the natural 1 came back.** **Thirty minutes later** Addison used it to **disqualify Blarg's attempt to intervene in [[Binks Stonevein]]'s bargain with [[Lolth]]** — *"you rolled a nat 1 on that last relation check."* He had warned Binks off both in character (*"if you piss off another God, I swear to God"*) and out of it (*"What a great idea. Yeah. What could happen?"*), and was overruled twice: once by the table vote, once by his own earlier dice. **Bad rolls are being banked as narrative debt at this table.**
- ⭐⭐ **TWO NATURAL 20s, AND THEY ROUTE THE ENTIRE RESCUE.** With [[Binks Stonevein]] swallowed by a 40-foot globe of impregnable darkness, **Blarg's natural-20 arcana for 31** (`1d20+11` — his S24-established *Divine Order: Thaumaturge* bonus) identified it as **drow magic** *"far more powerful than it should be,"* penetrated it, and got [[Selûne]] to **spotlight both [[Binks Stonevein]] and [[Darby Stonefeather]] on moonbeams only he can see** — *"you get your moonlit dark vision, that beams of moonlight that only you can see."* Addison granted a **bonus religion check for the nat 20**, and **he rolled a second natural 20 for 29.** Through that one he heard **[[Selûne]] calling** and a song coming up the tunnels — *"some kind of divine yet primordial druidic, yet. None of the above"* — and **recognised it as [[Kit Aluri]]**: *"She just Misty Stepped probably 200 yards."* She arrived in the same breath. ⭐ **Kit materialised standing next to him.**
- **He stabilises the casualty.** During the short rest, an **arcana 13** (`1d20+11` `[2]`) still earned him the knowledge — Addison: *"You know that you can restore more hit points with Cure Wounds. You also know that a Lesser Restoration or a Greater Restoration would do the trick."* He then cast a **third-level Cure Wounds for 24** — `6d8+5` `[4,1,2,4,1,7]` — bringing [[Ormic]] back from *"like one hit point."* 🛑 **He is now the party's only healer.**
- **Above the table** he voted **for** Binks's action to stand, on character-agency grounds: *"It's his character's agency. He can talk to Lolth. Lolth if he wants to."* And his verdict on the cost, delivered without irony: *"With the character as well. It's perfect."*
- ✅ **6 DDB archive rolls cross-referenced** — the first session in a while he appears in the archive at all. ⚠️ **His religion modifier here is +9**; his S24 note records conflicting values of +4 and 12. **The archive settles S25 at +9.**
- ⚠️ **One archive-only roll of his sits 27 minutes AFTER the recording stopped** — Religion `1d20+9` `[10]` = **19** at 19:15:54Z, during the post-session hangout. **No transcript context exists and none can be reconstructed.**

### S25.5 Key Events ([[Session 25.5 — Sucks to Suck, Nerd]])

> 🛑 **Numbering unresolved** — on-disk `Session 25.5`, frontmatter `session_number: 27`, transcript byte-identical to S26's. Reads as the **post-break tail of the S25 play night.** If it folds into S25, this entry merges there.
>
> ⚠️ **No in-fiction scene exists in this segment.** It is a 20-minute post-play level-up and administration block.

- ⭐ **[[Selûne]] gave him a permanent boon he never asked for.** *"Selûne is giving you that emanation for free. And you feel. I mean, you're essentially at this point at level six. Dude, you're kind of. You have this emanation, this natural mint green bioluminescence about you that is strictly lunar… You're emanating your own little aura of lunar energy."* Harmless but *"uncomfortable"* to be near. **Unprompted, free, and not switchable.** ⚠️ No mechanics stated — no radius, light level, or interaction with stealth.
- ⭐ **He tried to save Ormic's soul with Ceremony and his own god told him to wait.** *"since your alignment has changed, Matthew, can I atonement you right back basically with Ceremony?"* Addison called for **Religion**; the result was **19**; the answer was *"it would be ill advised to try to… At least this early on in the process. This fresh. It's very fresh."* He withdrew voluntarily: *"Yeah, okay. Okay, then we don't."* 🛑 **The route is deferred on timing, not refused** — meaning Ormic's condition is intended to persist across sessions and Blarg's Ceremony gambit stays live. Watch for the gate to open after in-game time passes.
- ⚠️ **Addison rejected his attempt to opt out of noticing.** Florian first hedged *"I don't think Blarg would know that anything has changed if nothing physically has changed. For now, until something happens,"* and Addison shut it down flatly: ***"That's not true at all."*** (In fairness the change was visible on Ormic's body anyway.) **Precedent: players do not get to decline in-fiction knowledge their character would have.** See [[House Rules & Rulings]].
- **He now has Augury**, and announced it as a standing claim on the DM: *"I have Augury now, and so you're just gonna need to answer all my questions from now on. As long as I've got second-level spell slots available."*
- 🛑 **He ranked [[Demogorgon]] above [[Lolth]] and Addison used it to reorder the campaign's threat table out loud.** Blarg: *"I think Demogorgon is a bigger problem. For real? For real. So maybe it's a needed alliance for the moment, but we're gonna get over anyways."* Addison: *"I mean, it's cute that you think the Prince of. The Prince of Demons from the Abyss is the worst of your problems."* ⭐ **Demogorgon has anchored the campaign's ceiling since S20. This is the first time he is explicitly told he is not.**
- **Gallows humour over his friend's prospects** — *"but it would really be a shame if Binks wouldn't make it to the next one"* (⚠️ 45%-confidence correction, see Continuity Flag 11) and the practical party line: *"You need some rest. We probably have to fight off whatever's coming without you. Maybe. Anyways."*
- **Gave the fullest physical description of himself on record**, from memory, after [[Kit Aluri]] asked for reference art for a party portrait and his written version turned out to be lost. See **Description / Appearance**. **Above-table.**
- **Religion 19** is his only roll this session. ⚠️ **Physical dice, transcript-only** — the archive was not queried in this run, and zero rows is the expected result.
